function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The presence of duplicate `patient_id` values (48 patients with multiple `sample_seq`) means that some patients appear in more than one row. To ensure one row per patient, we must deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. This is necessary because the estimand is about the fraction of patients (not rows) in the treatment arm who responded. Without deduplication, re-tested patients would be double-counted, potentially biasing the result if their response status varied across tests. We will deduplicate on `patient_id` using `sample_seq` as the priority."}
